q1_issues.issue: The whole clause is compressed into a single MeasureAtMost atom: the superlative subject NP ("the highest amount of points") and the "possible" modality leave no trace, so nothing records that a maximum attainable value is being specified rather than an observed bound.

The scale slot repeats the unit (point as both scale and unit) instead of naming a surface dimension, so the measure carries no usable dimension label and will not match any dimension-scaled question.
The entity slot holds the bare kind report, a position the Measures section only ever fills with an individual or group witness; a Measure on a kind does not distribute to any actual report.

q2_gaps: specificational / equative copular clause whose subject is a superlative quantity description and whose complement is a value ("The highest amount of points possible on reports is 10 points", "The maximum is 10") — Superlative covers "X is the ADJ-est N", not a description equated with a measured value
"amount of N" / "number of N" as a quantity-denoting NP that is itself the subject of the predication
a generic / kind-level Measure (a measure asserted of a bare kind rather than of an individual or group witness), and how attainability modality ("possible", "maximum") attaches to a measure bound
notes: Mapping "the highest ... is 10" onto the MeasureAtMost bound is a defensible reading of an uncovered construction; the defects are the collapsed structure and the malformed slot fills, not the choice of bound.
